end.summary:
Practised defining food miles and identifying where foods come from.
Connected longer distances with greater fuel use and possible freshness effects.
Rohan answered 2 of 3 attempts without help.
By the end, they compared spinach at 15 km with apples at 350 km.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the meaning of food miles with Rohan using distance, fuel, and freshness examples. Rohan initially mixed up the on-screen labels and repeated the fuel answer, but later stated that food miles are the distance food travels and compared two foods using kilometres. At home, ask them to choose two foods and explain which has more food miles and why.
